apps.title: Apps (App Store or Google Play)
apps.description: App Store URLs or numeric IDs (e.g. https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id310633997) and/or Google Play URLs or package names (e.g. com.whatsapp). Mix both stores freely.

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: Two-letter country codes (us, gb, fr, de…). Each app is scraped for each country (unless the App Store URL already contains a country).

language.title: Language (Google Play)
language.description: Two-letter language code used for Google Play reviews (en, fr, de, es…).

maxReviewsPerApp.title: Max reviews per app and country
maxReviewsPerApp.description: Most recent reviews first. App Store public feed is limited to the 500 most recent reviews per country; Google Play up to 5,000.

minRating.title: Minimum rating
minRating.description: Only keep reviews with at least this many stars.

maxRating.title: Maximum rating
maxRating.description: Only keep reviews with at most this many stars (e.g. 2 to get only negative reviews).

includeSummary.title: Add insight summary per app
includeSummary.description: Adds one summary item per app and country: average rating of the sample, rating distribution, rating by app version, top complaint and praise keywords.

monitorMode.title: Monitoring mode (only new reviews)
monitorMode.description: Remember reviews already seen and output only NEW reviews on each run. Schedule the Actor daily or weekly to get alerts on new reviews. The first run is a baseline.

monitorName.title: Monitoring list name
monitorName.description: Use different names to keep several independent monitored lists.
